row.scim_addon_price_text: Atlassian Guard Standard $4.20/u/mo (Atlassian.com purchases on Business or Business + AI)
row.evidence: Loom's pricing page lists 'Advanced security (SSO, SCIM)' under Enterprise (Contact Sales) and says Atlassian Guard Standard is included in Enterprise for free; the help article says the workspace must be on Enterprise to set up SSO and provisioning.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Business correction: the pricing data lists Business at $180/yr ($15/u/mo annual) and $18 monthly; June's $18 was the monthly figure. Business + AI $240/yr ($20 annual, $24 monthly). Two SCIM paths: Loom.com Enterprise workspaces use a WorkOS-backed Directory Sync (bearer token, configurable deactivate-or-delete deprovisioning, loomMemberRole custom attribute); Atlassian-integrated workspaces (all sign-ups since February 2026) use Atlassian Guard Standard SCIM 2.0 at api.atlassian.com/scim/directory/{id}, included in Enterprise. Atlassian.com Business/Business + AI buyers can add Guard separately; Guard Standard is now listed at $4.20/u/mo (June said $4). Loom says it has no open API.

scim.addon_price_text: Atlassian Guard Standard, $4.20/user/month (Atlassian.com Business / Business + AI)

auth.token_source: Atlassian Administration > Security > User security > Identity providers > directory > Set up user provisioning (API key); Loom.com: Workspace settings > Security > Configure Directory Sync (WorkOS setup guide)
auth.token_expiry: 1 year (Atlassian SCIM API keys created or regenerated since January 2025)

deprovision.data_retained: Loom.com path: default Deactivate keeps the content on the deactivated account (posted content stays accessible); admins can switch to Delete with content transferred to an Admin/Creator or deleted. Atlassian path: DELETE deactivates the managed account (same as active=false).

custom.how: Custom attribute loomMemberRole (default, creator, viewer, admin) under urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User sets the Loom role; Atlassian path maps nickName to Public name.

roles.how: loomMemberRole attribute (default/creator/viewer/admin), typically set per IdP group (e.g. Loom Creators, Loom Viewers, Loom Admins).

limitations.text: Atlassian provisioning recommends at most 1 million users per directory connection.
SSO must be configured (with a verified domain) before Directory Sync on Loom.com workspaces.

scim.notes: Base URL and version are for the Atlassian Guard path (Atlassian-integrated workspaces). Loom.com legacy Enterprise workspaces get a WorkOS-issued endpoint and bearer token, whose URL pattern is not published.

limitations.text: No open API; the LoomSDK is not a user-management API.

user_api.notes: Loom says it has no open API; the Loom SDK is for embedding recording. Atlassian-integrated workspaces are administered in Atlassian Administration, whose own admin APIs are outside this record.

okta.notes: Okta's Atlassian Cloud app serves Atlassian-managed Loom workspaces; no standalone Loom OIN page (okta.com/integrations/loom/ is 404). Loom.com workspaces add SCIM to their own Okta SAML app via WorkOS.

entra.notes: Atlassian Cloud gallery app; no Loom-specific tutorial (loom-tutorial is 404).

google.notes: Atlassian documents Google Workspace user provisioning for Atlassian organizations.

onelogin.notes: Atlassian links OneLogin provisioning instructions; OneLogin catalogue page not checked (blocks bots).

jumpcloud.notes: Atlassian links JumpCloud provisioning instructions; JumpCloud catalogue page not checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Domain capture: users signing up with a verified domain automatically join the Enterprise workspace.
fallbacks.notes: Without SCIM, users are provisioned just in time at SSO sign-in.
